authority: User decisions; CW and AIGMos evolve concurrently, not final LOCKED

confirmed.one_error: Exactly one Error mechanism applies everywhere: pre-CS BOOT, INPUT, STATE, TER, CS, EXPOSE and Core/System/User modules. No parallel authoritative error subsystem.
confirmed.cso: CS = command input; execution output = OK (success no payload), actual command response when there is one (no mandatory wrapper), or ERROR under unified Error contract.
confirmed.errors_buffer: config.json defines Error Buffer count: positive integer N holds latest N errors; 0 retains all entries. Independent from Log Buffer.
confirmed.error_cs_trace: Every Error during a CS invocation causes one corresponding CS log record with executed command and parameters, even when logger mode off. Never duplicate if mode cs/ac already recorded that invocation.
confirmed.error_ac: When AC is runtime-active, Error includes available AC actor/identity information for any logging mode; never invent a missing actor.
confirmed.error_without_cs: BOOT/module errors use same Error mechanism even when no CS execution exists; no fabricated CS record.
confirmed.always_available: Errors and mandatory failure-linked CS log remain active regardless of optional continuous logger.

derived_constraints: One Error protocol across runtime, not a sixth Hardcore mechanism.
An Error must not require optional AC, Q, UI, logger mode cs/ac or Expose to exist.
Error and Log Buffer are independent counts and records.
Protect credentials when capturing full CS command/parameters.
0 means all, not disabled; possible memory pressure requires target-aware validation, not silent cap.
Retain original ERROR if optional logging sink fails.
legacy_evidence: new/docs/contracts/shared_error_audit_log_schema.json defines AIGMOS_ERROR_V1 fields and redaction as legacy reference; 2.0 locked/audit clauses not adopted.
new/system/lib/contracts/errors.py provides build_contract_error and redact_for_contract, not a universal live dispatcher.
new/system/cs/parser.py / reporter.py still use legacy text error and $SYSTEM.ERRORS; BOOT/TER use boot_log.
open: Precise Error shape and unambiguous internal tagging for payload text OK/ERROR.
Error mechanism/buffer owner, early BOOT before config.json, user module access without violating CS/STATE rules.
Exact config.json keys/default counts and memory policy for 0=all.
MEM vs optional FILE save/reload, buffer failure, correlation/duplicate handling.
Parameter-level secret redaction and error/log read/export access control.
tests: CS success with no value returns OK; with value returns actual value.
CS failure in mode off yields ERROR + Error Buffer + one CS command+parameters log.
CS failure in cs/ac does not double-log.
AC-active Error has actor independent of logging mode.
BOOT and User Module Error use same common format.
Buffer count 1 keeps newest, 0 keeps all.
No secret-bearing raw values in visible error/log.
